teachingQuestion: How does a continuity exercise test the mission rather than only a technology component?
focalInsight: Continuity evidence spans function, people, process, technology, suppliers, facilities, communications, and acceptance.
title: Continuity exercise path
caption: Injects expose assumptions before a real disruption does.
altSummary: A continuity exercise starts with a critical function and dependencies, injects a realistic disruption, observes decisions and workarounds, and turns gaps into owned improvements.
textFallback: Define the critical function and its people, process, technology, supplier, facility, and communication dependencies. Introduce a realistic disruption, observe workaround and escalation decisions, record assumptions and failures, assign improvements, and retest.
